stem:
Household incomes, in thousands of dollars, in a certain country are represented by the random variable $X$ with mean $\mu$ and standard deviation $\sigma$. The incomes of a random sample of 400 households are found and the results are summarised below.

$$n = 400 \qquad \Sigma x = 923 \qquad \Sigma x^2 = 3170$$

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: A random sample of 50 households in one particular region of the country is taken and the sample mean income, in thousands of dollars, is found to be 2.6. Using your values from part **(i)**, test at the 5% significance level whether household incomes in this region are greater, on average, than in the country as a whole.
